items.t: Why Amazon Wants the Chips and Blackstone Wants the Buildings
items.sum: Amazon is selling a 75.1% stake in 13 data center shells to Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust for about $5 billion, recycling cash into AI chips amid negative free cash flow and heavy bond issuance.

items.t: Blackstone’s Gray says market shakeout could benefit firm
items.sum: Investing.com -- Blackstone President and Chief Operating Officer Jon Gray said the recent market shakeout could ultimately benefit the private equity giant, arguing that investor negativity has gone too far even as he warned of elevated bubble risks in parts of the market.

items.t: OMERS and Blackstone-Backed Transmission Developers Form Partnership to Pursue Toronto Third Line
items.sum: TORONTO, November 18, 2026--OMERS and Transmission Developers Infrastructure - Canada Co. ("TDI"), a Blackstone portfolio company, today announced that they have formed a partnership to pursue the Independent Electricity System Operator’s ("IESO") upcoming Toronto Third Line ("TTL") procurement.
